app.name: StreamVerse
app.tagline: Share your videos with the world

nav.signedOutHint: Sign in to find your subscriptions, watch history and saved videos.

common.errorRetry: Could not load this data. Try again.

home.heroSubtitle: Video streaming and live broadcasting platform.
home.emptyHint: Upload the first one and it will appear here once processing is done.

browse.title: Browse
browse.searchNote: Title-only matching on this page. Weighted full-text search lives on /search.

watch.unavailableHint: This video is private, still processing, or has been taken down.
watch.processing: This video is still being processed.
watch.relatedNote: Suggested from shared tags and category — no personal profiling.

player.errorHint: The stream could not be loaded. Try again.
player.notSupported: Your browser cannot play this video.
player.shortcuts: Shortcuts: space = play/pause, arrows = +/- 5s, M = mute, F = fullscreen

upload.title: Upload a video
upload.subtitle: Uploads are resumable: a network drop resumes where it stopped.
upload.dropzoneHint: or click to browse - MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI - {{max}} max
upload.videoTitlePlaceholder: Give your video a clear title
upload.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what your video is about
upload.loginRequired: Sign in to upload a video.
upload.invalidType: Unsupported format. Use MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM or AVI.
upload.pipelineNote: After upload: file analysis, encoding at several qualities, thumbnail generation, then publication.

studio.title: Studio
studio.subtitle: Your videos, their transcoding state and their stats.
studio.empty: You have not uploaded any video yet.
studio.emptyHint: Upload your first video to see it here.
studio.engagementNotice: No engagement data yet. Counters will appear with the first views.
studio.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete "{{title}}"? Every encoded quality and thumbnail will be erased.
studio.retryOnlyFailed: Only failed videos can be retried.
studio.engagementLive: Views, likes and comments are counted live. A view only counts after a minimum watch time, and repeat viewings by the same person count once.

visibility.publicHint: Visible to everyone and listed in the catalogue.
visibility.unlistedHint: Reachable only via its direct link.

video.publishBlocked: A video can only be published once it is ready.

form.title: Title
form.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter

auth.loginSubtitle: Access your studio and your uploads.
auth.registerSubtitle: An activation email will be sent to you.
auth.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase, digits, hyphen or underscore. Doubles as your channel address.
auth.registered: Account created. Check your inbox to activate it.
auth.activated: Account activated. You can sign in now.
auth.activationFailed: This activation link is invalid or has expired.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.resetSubtitle: We will send you a reset link.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that address, a link has just been sent.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
auth.registeredSpam: The email usually arrives within a minute. Remember to check your spam folder.

account.title: My profile
account.subtitle: Your public channel identity.
account.sessionHint: Signing out clears this session’s tokens on this device only. Your other devices stay signed in.
account.avatarHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF. 5 MB max.
account.imageType: Unsupported format. Choose a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
account.bioHint: Shown at the top of your channel.
account.setPasswordHint: You sign in with Google. Set a password if you also want to sign in with your e-mail address.

validation.usernamePattern: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore only.
validation.url: Invalid link. It must start with http:// or https://.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.subtitle: This page does not exist or has moved.

engagement.loginToReact: Sign in to react to this video.
engagement.noCommentsHint: Be the first to react to this video.
engagement.deleteConfirm: Delete this comment? Its replies will be removed too.
engagement.reportDetailsPlaceholder: Give the moderation team useful context.
engagement.reportSent: Report submitted. The moderation team will review it.
engagement.reportNotice: Reports are reviewed manually. There is no automated copyright detection.

channel.noVideosHint: This channel has not published a video yet.
channel.notFoundHint: This username does not exist, or the account was suspended.
channel.noFollowNotice: No subscriptions or notifications in v1 — browsing is deliberately follow-less.
channel.followNotice: Following adds this channel's new videos to your subscriptions feed. No notification is sent.

search.title: Search
search.emptyQueryHint: Type a title, a tag, or words from the description.
search.noResultsHint: Check the spelling, or try broader words.
search.engineNote: Searches titles, tags and descriptions. Minor typos are tolerated.

live.title: Live now
live.subtitle: Channels broadcasting right now.
live.noneLiveHint: No one is broadcasting right now. Start your own from the studio.
live.notFoundHint: This channel does not exist or has been disabled.
live.offlineHint: The stream will appear here as soon as broadcasting starts.
live.chatEmpty: No messages yet. Start the conversation!
live.chatDisabled: Chat is disabled on this channel.
live.studioSubtitle: Stream key, channel settings and session history.
live.obsHint: Copy these two values into OBS: Settings > Stream > Custom service.
live.streamKeyHint: The OBS \u201cStream Key\u201d field. The slug is public; the key is secret.
live.rotateWarning: The old key stops working immediately. You will need to update OBS before your next broadcast.
live.keySecrecyWarning: Never share your stream key or show it on screen during a broadcast: it lets anyone broadcast on your channel.
live.chatEnabledHint: Signed-in viewers can post during the broadcast.
live.recordSessionsHint: The recording is converted into a private video through the usual VOD pipeline.
live.recordingNote: Recordings become private videos: publishing them stays your choice.

broadcast.title: Go live from this device
broadcast.hint: The camera and mic on this phone or computer. Nothing to install.
broadcast.previewEmpty: Turn on the camera to see what your viewers will see.
broadcast.insecureContext: Your browser only allows camera access over HTTPS (or on localhost). Open the site over HTTPS to broadcast from this device.
broadcast.errorDenied: Camera or microphone access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
broadcast.errorNoDevice: No usable camera or microphone on this device.
broadcast.errorBusyDevice: The camera is already in use by another app.
broadcast.errorNoH264: This browser cannot encode H264, which broadcasting requires. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge or Safari.
broadcast.errorUnsupported: This browser does not support live broadcasting.
broadcast.errorRejected: Broadcast refused. Reload the page and try again.
broadcast.errorConnect: Could not reach the broadcast server.
broadcast.errorDropped: The connection dropped. The stream has stopped.

admin.title: Ad campaigns
admin.subtitle: First-party rotation: delivery, caps, pause and resume.
admin.noCampaignsHint: Create a campaign to start serving.
admin.weightHint: Weight 3 is served 3x as often as weight 1.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete campaign "{{title}}"? Recorded impressions will be lost.
admin.scopeNote: First-party ad rotation: no VAST/VPAID, no ad network, no bidding. No third-party script is loaded in the viewer's browser.
admin.creativeReplaceHint: Leave empty to keep the current creative.

billing.title: Go Premium
billing.subtitle: Support creators and watch with no ads at all.
billing.sandboxBody: Payments are simulated: no real money is taken. The full flow — asynchronous confirmation, signature verification, idempotency — still runs.
billing.cancelConfirm: Cancel your subscription? You keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.
billing.cancelled: Subscription cancelled. Access continues to the end of the period.
billing.cancelledNotice: Auto-renewal is off. You keep access until the date shown.
billing.providerNote: Mobile money and cards go through one provider interface. The simulator can be swapped for a real provider without changing the rest of the code.
billing.phoneHint: The number that will receive the confirmation request.
billing.cardHint: Simulation: no full card number is requested or stored.
billing.checkoutNotice: The provider confirms the payment asynchronously. Your subscription activates when that confirmation arrives.
billing.awaitingMobileMoney: Approve the request sent to {{phone}}. This page updates automatically.
billing.awaitingCard: Your bank is validating the payment. This page updates automatically.
billing.paymentFailedHint: Nothing was charged. You can try again.

moderation.title: Moderation queue
moderation.subtitle: Reports awaiting review, decisions and sanctions.
moderation.oldestPending: The oldest report has been waiting {{age}}.
moderation.queueEmptyHint: No report is waiting for review.
moderation.author: Author
moderation.reasonRequired: Required (10 characters minimum). This text is sent to the author.
moderation.auditNote: Every decision is timestamped, attributed and kept in the audit log.

library.title: My library
library.subtitle: Your history, bookmarks, likes and the channels you follow.
library.clearHistoryConfirm: Clear your entire watch history? This cannot be undone. Creators' view counts are not affected.
library.emptyHistoryHint: Videos you watch will appear here.
library.emptyBookmarksHint: Save a video to find it here later.
library.emptyLikedHint: Videos you like will appear here.
library.emptyFollowingHint: Follow a channel to see its new videos.
library.emptyFeedHint: The channels you follow have not posted recently.
library.loginToSave: Sign in to save a video.
library.loginToFollow: Sign in to follow a channel.
library.subscriptionsSubtitle: The latest from the channels you follow.
library.feedNote: Strictly chronological: the newest videos from the channels you follow. No algorithmic ranking.

shorts.title: Shorts
shorts.emptyHint: Upload a vertical video under 90 seconds and it appears here automatically.
shorts.rankingNote: Randomised by default, or sorted however you choose. No algorithmic ranking optimised for engagement.
shorts.isShort: This video is a Short: vertical format, under 90 seconds.

seo.browse: Browse the StreamVerse catalogue by category, duration and popularity.
seo.live: Streams broadcasting right now on StreamVerse.
seo.premium: Go Premium: ad-free playback and top quality.
seo.shorts: Short vertical videos, full screen, on StreamVerse.
